We booked a taxi for a 12-day trip during February–March, and our journey became truly memorable thanks to our driver, Tapan.

From the very beginning, Tapan was punctual and welcomed us warmly at Guwahati Railway Station. He is a calm, friendly, and knowledgeable person who went above and beyond to make our trip enjoyable. Based on our interests and his local expertise, he suggested and guided us to many beautiful places that we might have otherwise missed.

One of his recommendations was the Arch Bridge, which turned out to be a stunning destination with scenery reminiscent of Dawki. I had also expressed a desire to visit Sela Lake, and Tapan made sure we could experience it. We were fortunate enough to enjoy snowfall there, which became one of the highlights of our trip.

Throughout the journey, Tapan felt more like a family member than a driver. His guidance was invaluable. When I shared my travel itinerary with him, he honestly advised us against visiting certain waterfalls because there was very little water during that season. His advice proved absolutely correct, as most waterfalls we encountered were dry. However, he helped us find a beautiful waterfall near Kaziranga where there was still flowing water, allowing us to enjoy our first waterfall experience of the trip.

In Tawang, we visited the monastery, the war memorial, and many other attractions along the route. Tapan patiently stopped wherever we wished to explore and ensured that we had enough time to enjoy each place. His kindness, professionalism, and genuine care made our journey comfortable and stress-free.

A heartfelt thank you to Tapan, Jyoti Travels, and Cloud Valley Travels for their excellent service and for helping us create such wonderful memories. We highly recommend them to anyone planning a trip to Northeast India.
